product.name: Waveline Rechargeable Air Pump
product.description:
Keep your home, garage, or utility space fresh, dry and comfortable with the Waveline Portable Desiccant Dehumidifier — a premium, high-performance solution designed to remove excess moisture even in the coldest environments. Operating effectively between -5°C and 50°C, this advanced desiccant system delivers reliable performance all year round, where standard compressor units struggle.

Ideal for homes, garages, sheds, caravans, boats, and utility rooms, it prevents damp, mould, and condensation while protecting your belongings from moisture damage. The compact and elegant design features a lightweight body with a built-in carry handle, making it easy to move from room to room or use on the go.

With a powerful 10-litre per day dehumidifying capacity, 2-litre removable tank, and optional continuous drain, it’s practical as well as efficient. The laundry-drying function uses internal heat up to 150°C to help dry and freshen clothes naturally — perfect for cold winter months when outdoor drying isn’t possible.

The Waveline dehumidifier includes a washable dust filter, adjustable airflow (0–90°), and simple digital controls with selectable humidity levels (50%, 60%, Auto), timer settings (2h/4h/8h), and three fan speeds (Low/Mid/High) for personalised comfort. Safety features such as auto shut-off, tip-over protection, and auto restart after power cuts ensure dependable, worry-free operation in any setting.

Crafted from high-quality materials and engineered for efficiency, this is a premium-grade dehumidifier built to perform wherever you need it most — from protecting your home to maintaining dry, comfortable conditions in caravans, workshops, and storage spaces.

Temperature-Activated Operation

The cylinder works through heat expansion. As the greenhouse temperature rises, the cylinder expands to open the vent, helping increase ventilation. As temperatures fall, it contracts to allow the vent to close.

product.name: ENGO E25 Smart Thermostat Starter Pack Zigbee Radiator Control White
product.description:
The ENGO E25 smart thermostat starter pack is a Zigbee wireless system for room-by-room radiator heating control within the ENGO smart heating ecosystem. The pack contains the E25 battery thermostat, one ENGO smart radiator valve and the ENGO E-Gate Pro gateway, so app control and schedules are ready from day one.

The E25 thermostat measures the temperature in the room and sends heating setpoints wirelessly to the smart radiator valve, which opens and closes to regulate the radiator's heat output. The thermostat has two radios, ZigBee 3.0 (2.4 GHz) and a separate 868 MHz radio. One thermostat can control up to 6 ENGO smart radiator valves in the same room, so more valves can be added later.

Heating schedules, timers and smart automation are created in the ENGO Smart app through the included E-Gate Pro gateway. Schedules are set in the app, not on the thermostat. On the wall, three buttons (Up, OK, Down) let you change the temperature, and without a gateway the thermostat can also run on its own in day mode, with no schedule. With the gateway and the ENGO Smart app you can also use voice control with Alexa or Google Home.

The thermostat runs on 2 x AA batteries and needs no supply cables. The system is designed for ENGO smart heating products and is not compatible with other brands or generic Zigbee hubs.

In the box: E25 battery thermostat (with 2 x AA batteries), one ENGO smart radiator valve and the ENGO E-Gate Pro gateway.

product.description:
Hozelock 1583 Aquaforce 6000 Garden Pond Pump and Filter

The Aquaforce 6000 is an extremely efficient filter and waterfall pump.
The Aquaforce case incorporates an exclusive wildlife protection system; protecting small fish, newts and frogs from accessing the pump.
The Wildlife Protection System reduces the risk of damage to common pond wildlife. For extra protection of species such as newts we recommend using an additional cage, available as a spare part.

Key Features:
Conical impeller - maximises performance
Self Cooling System - gives continuously perfect conditions
Ceramic Bearings - maximise pump life
Large cage surface area reduces cage clogging  improves water purity
Wildlife Protection System - protects small fish, newts, frogs, etc from accessing the pump
Carry handle - easy lifting in and out of the pond

How does Aquaforce work 

Pond water is drawn in through the cage grill which filters out coarse solids up to 6mm/10mm in size (dependent on model). Smaller particles down to 2mm in size can be eliminated by fitting the supplied clip-in fine mesh filter tray which affords the best possible protection for pond fish, preventing them from accessing the pump.

The Aquaforce has a considerably increased cage surface area, which allows the maximum amount of waste to be collected and pumped to the filter system. It also means that the cage is far less likely to clog, which will save you from constant cleaning.

Hozelock 5m Pond Hose

Made from high quality plastics this spiral hose is extremely flexible with a bend radius only 3 times its diameter without kinking or splitting.

product.name: Vauxhall Movano (2021+) Fixed Driver Side Window, and Fitting Kit, Privacy, Camper
product.description:
Upgrade your vehicle with our precision engineered Van Windows - built for perfect fitment, lasting quality and everyday reliability. Manufactured to ISO 9001, CE and TUV standards, each window meets strict European safety requirements and is tailored to the exact contours of your van for a clean, factory quality finish. Ideal for camper conversions, trade use or replacing existing panels, these windows combine performance, durability and professional style.

Made from high strength tempered glass, each window is designed for maximum safety and clarity. In the event of impact, the glass shatters into small blunt fragments rather than sharp shards, reducing the risk of injury. The tint is integrated during manufacturing, not applied as a film, allowing around 30 percent light transmission to create privacy and reduce glare. Unlike surface coatings, the built in tint will not fade, bubble or peel, keeping your van looking smart for years to come.

Opening window options feature a smooth sliding mechanism on an internal rail with a secure latch that automatically locks when closed. An integrated drainage channel directs water safely outside, keeping your interior dry and protected in all weather. Fixed window versions offer the same precision fit and premium finish for a seamless, professional appearance.

Every Van Window is delivered in custom packaging with heavy duty protective inserts to ensure it arrives safely. Available individually or as a full set, and with optional fitting kits, they make installation straightforward and reliable. Combining exact fitment, premium materials and safety tested construction, our Van Windows provide the perfect balance of style, security and practicality for any van upgrade.

product.description:
Vinyl Bathroom Runner - Non-slip and Hard-wearing
The attractive bath mat made of a robust vinyl-polyester mix convinces with a resistant structure and its durability. Thanks to the slip-resistant PVC backing and the high dead weight, this bathroom floor covering always stays in the desired position and does not slip. Furthermore, the insensitive bathroom carpet has an impact sound-absorbing and dirt-repellent effect and is thus optimally suited for your bathroom furnishings. Thanks to its cold-insulating properties, this bath mat also protects you from an unpleasantly cold floor after a bath or shower. Of course, the bath mat can also be used in rooms with underfloor heating.
Individual design - many designs available
Discover our large selection of different sizes, colours and designs in the bathroom rugs and thus design your bathroom individually. Whether it's just a small shower mat or a complete bath set - you'll find the right thing for your personal oasis of well-being in the bathroom at home. For a modern look, you can choose from a variety of strong and subtle colours. You can easily cut the bath mats to your own personal dimensions, or to cut out corners, for example, using a cutting tool.
Easy-care and quick to clean
The fibres of the shower mat do not absorb dirt. Contaminants remain on the surface and can thus be easily removed with a hoover or a little water. Mould stains or mould growth do not occur, as moisture does not soak into the fibres of the bathroom rugs and the bathroom floor coverings dry again quickly as a result.

product.name: Reliance AR18 Aquasystem 18 Litre 3.5 Bar 3/4 MI Potable Expansion Vessel with Hose & Service Valve XVES 050 051
product.description:
Includes

- 18 Litre Potable Expansion Vessel
- 1m Expansion Vessel Hose 3/4″ M x F
- Tesla 3/4″ Expansion Vessel Service Valve For Potable Vessels

All Aquasystem expansion vessels are supplied with a replaceable membrane, which separates the water and air, to prevent contamination of the water system, corrosion of the expansion vessel or pressure loss in the water system.

The main purpose of an expansion vessel is to compensate for the increase in volume of water due to the varying water temperatures in hot water or heating systems. When water is heated it expands and as water is not compressible this increased volume will create a rise in pressure within the system. As an example, water being heated from 0°C-100°C will increase by approx 4.5%.

The expansion vessel allows for this extra space, as when water temperature increases the membrane inside the vessel inflates to allow the water to fill the vessel. The membrane will continue to expand until the system reaches its maximum temperature. Once this has been reached the membrane will be fully inflated and takes up the capacity of the vessel shell. Gradually the temperature will drop, which will in turn decrease the volume of water. Due to the pressure from the pressurised air surrounding the membrane, water will start to exit the vessel until the membrane is deflated.

product.name: 3/4 BSP Water Butt Fitting with Full Flow PP Valve and 20mm MDPE Fitting
product.description:
MDPE (Medium-Density Polyethylene) fittings are essential components in piping systems, specifically designed for connecting MDPE pipes. Known for their durability, flexibility, and chemical resistance, MDPE fittings are widely used in applications such as water supply, irrigation, and industrial processes. These fittings, feature threaded compression connections that ensure a tight, leak-free seal without the need for specialized equipment, making them both cost-effective and easy to install. 
An MDPE straight connector is a type of pipe fitting used to join two pieces of piping or tubing in a straight line, without any angle or deviation. It's a simple yet essential component in plumbing, fluid transport, and various other applications where a direct, uninterrupted connection between two pipes is needed.
MDPE PN10 pipe fittings are engineered to withstand a maximum pressure of 10 bars (approximately 145 psi), ensuring the integrity of the piping system under various conditions. These fittings are not only durable, capable of withstanding harsh weather and mechanical stress, but also resistant to corrosion from chemicals and acids, which contributes to their longevity and reduces maintenance needs. Overall, MDPE fittings provide a reliable, versatile, and efficient solution for a wide range of piping applications.

product.name: Shower Seal for Screens Doors or Panels, Fits 4, 5 or 6mm Glass, Seals Gaps Up to 15mm, 2000mm Length, SEAL051
product.description:
This shower seal is comprised of a high quality rigid PVC U section designed to comfortably grip any glass ranging from 4mm to 6mm thick with no need for any additional adhesive. The bottom of the seal has a soft flexible bubble which will seal any gap from 10mm to 15mm.

These seals are commonly found on either the bottom horizontal section of a bath screen or shower door, and can also be used vertically on the upright of the glass to create a seal between the glass and the tiles or wall. Please note that this is a straight shower seal designed only for use on straight glass.

This product comes in 800mm, 900mm, 1400mm or 2000mm lengths and can be cut down to size once you’ve received it.

Installation of our seals is nice and easy. Simply push the seal onto the glass from below on one end and work your way along, pushing the seal up onto the glass as you go. Do not try to slide the seals along the glass as this can damage it.

If you're struggling to find the correct seal for your shower/bath screen then please don't hesitate to get in contact with us. We would be more than happy to help.

product.name: camlock cam & groove layflat hose fittings type A, female bsp thread pump connector
product.description:
Camlock Type A fittings are a type of quick-connect coupling commonly used in fluid transfer systems. These fittings consist of a male adaptor with a male thread on one end and a camlock (grooved) connection on the other. The male thread allows the fitting to be connected to a female-threaded pipe or hose, while the camlock connection is designed to quickly and securely connect to a female camlock coupler (Types B, C, D, or DC).

Material: Camlock Type A fittings are typically made from a variety of materials, including aluminum, stainless steel, brass, and polypropylene, depending on the application requirements.

Sizes: These fittings are available in a range of sizes, typically from ½ inch to 6 inches, to accommodate different hose and pipe diameters.

Design Features:

Male Adaptor: One end has a male threaded adaptor, which can be screwed into a female-threaded component.
Grooved End: The opposite end features the camlock design, which includes a groove that allows the female camlock coupler to latch securely onto it using cam arms.
Uses of Camlock Type A Fittings:
Camlock Type A fittings are used in a wide range of industries due to their versatility and ease of use. Here are some common applications:

Fluid Transfer Systems:

Used in the transfer of liquids, including water, chemicals, petroleum products, and fuels, from one container or pipe to another.
Agriculture:

Employed in irrigation systems, pesticide spraying, and transferring liquid fertilizers.
Chemical Processing:

Utilized in industries where chemicals are transferred between tanks, pipes, and machinery.
Food and Beverage Industry:

Used in sanitary applications for transferring liquids like juices, milk, and other food-grade substances, especially when made from stainless steel or other sanitary materials.
Petroleum Industry:

Essential in the transfer of fuels and other petroleum-based liquids, where a secure, leak-proof connection is crucial.
Marine Industry:

product.name: Fullex Kinetica+ K4 3-Star Keyed-Alike Euro Cylinders - Chrome, 45/50 (95mm), 2 Extra (7 total)
product.description: Pair of high security TS007 3-Star Kinetica+ keyed-alike euro cylinders combining advanced anti-snap, anti-bump, anti-drill, anti-pick and anti-plug pull protection with its revolutionary anti-tilt cam and sprung anti-grip drive bar. Recognised as leading the field in euro cylinder security, Kinetica+ holds Secured by Design accreditation and provides outstanding resistance against lock-snapping attacks. Kinetica+ uses a variety of specially engineered, hardened steel anti-bump, drill, and pick pins, whilst its core is reinforced by a super-strong strengthening bar that ensures a robust and durable lock. Lock snapping is a huge concern, so Kinetica+ combines several defensive mechanisms. A sacrificial cut ensures the cylinder snaps in front of the vulnerable cam area, and at the moment of failure, an anti-grip drive bar springs forward, and is stopped by dual attack rods that fire sideways. The rotating cam moves independantly, and stops when its outer defence ring hits the barrels. Dual attack rods limit the space attacker can work in, making it impossible to push the drive bar backwards to release the cam. The attacker will also fail to grab the drive bar, due to the bars tapered anti-grip ends. Leaving no way of manipulating or removing the cam. An innovative anti-tilt mechanism prevents the cam section from lowering when the cylinder is snapped, reducing further the space an attacker has to manipulate the mechanism. Following a snap attack, Kinetica+ leaves the lock protected on the outside, and operational on the inside. IMPORTANT SIZE INFORMATION: Kinetica+ cylinder size is represented with the external measurement first, and internal measurement second. Size should be measured from face of cylinder to centre of screw hole. If your cylinder measures 35mm from outside face to centre of screw hole, and 45mm from centre of screw hole to inside face (80mm overall), then you should order a 35/45 (80mm) cylinder.
